FAQ

Didn't find an answer? Give us a call.

Renting and booking

Can we rent just one apartment outside the season?

No. From September to June we always let the whole complex to one group. Individual apartments are only available in July and August.

Can summer apartment guests use the wellness area?

Yes, for an extra charge. In summer, guests in individual apartments can also use the Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, relaxation room and hot tub. Prices and detailed rules will be published before the season starts.

How many people can stay?

29 people in fixed beds and another 8 on extra beds, 37 in total.

How does booking work?

Choose your dates in the booking system or call us. We send a confirmation and an advance invoice for 50%, payable within 14 days. Once paid, the dates are yours.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancelling more than 60 days before arrival is free. If you cancel later, the advance payment is forfeited.

Is there a minimum stay?

The whole property is let for at least 2 nights (4 nights over Christmas, New Year and Easter). Individual apartments in summer: at least 3 nights.

Prices and fees

What's included in the price?

Accommodation in the whole complex, towels, Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, relaxation room, hot tub, covered terrace, fire pit with firewood, darts, table football, 4 rowing boats with oars, Wi-Fi in the accommodation area and parking. Pool from May to September.

What costs extra?

Cleaning, handover and bed linen (CZK 1,950) are added to the booking automatically. Electricity is charged by actual use, CZK 8/kWh (including heating and any EV charging, in winter up to about CZK 3,000 a day), and the tourist tax at CZK 20 per person per night. Both are deducted from the security deposit. Extras such as the terrace kiosk can be added directly in the booking. In summer, when apartments are let, there is no charge for electricity or cleaning and no security deposit.

How much is the security deposit?

CZK 10,000 (2 nights), CZK 20,000 (3–4 nights) or CZK 30,000 (5–7 nights), paid by bank transfer no later than 3 days before arrival, or by card. On departure we deduct the electricity used, the tourist tax, any extra cleaning and any damage, and refund the rest within 7 days. No security deposit is required for apartments in summer.

Are the beds and extra beds made up?

When you rent the whole property, we make up beds for the number of guests you confirm no later than 3 days before arrival. You make up the extra beds yourselves; duvets, pillows and linen are in the wardrobe. In summer we also make up the extra bed in the apartments.

What if we leave a big mess?

Standard cleaning is added to the booking when renting the whole property; for apartments in summer it is included in the price. Exceptional mess is charged by actual time; the rate is in the terms and conditions.

Your stay

Where can we park?

Parking is free for 10 cars. 6 spaces are in the car park opposite the complex (just across the road), 2 below the terrace along the road and 2 in front of apartment no. 1. Caravans cannot be parked around the complex.

Can we charge an electric car?

Yes. There is a wallbox below the terrace and in front of apartment no. 1. Charging is billed as part of your metered electricity.

Can we camp or bring a caravan?

No, camping and caravan parking are not allowed around the complex.

Can we fish in the reservoir?

Yes, with a valid fishing licence and a paid fishing permit from the anglers' association.

Can we borrow a boat?

Yes. When you rent the whole property, all 4 rowing boats with oars are free for you; on a regular apartment stay you can borrow one of the 4 for free. Life jackets are compulsory for children and recommended for non-swimmers.

Can we bring our own food and drink?

Yes. Apartments 1–4 have a kitchenette with crockery, so you can cook for yourselves. Apartment 5's common room has a cooker, fridge and a bar with a beer tap. Between the covered terrace and the children's playground there is a fire pit with a grill. You are welcome to bring your own bottled drinks free of charge. Beer and lemonade in kegs for our tap are supplied only by us. For bigger parties we can arrange catering, or you can add the terrace kiosk to your booking.

How late can we be noisy?

Please keep the noise down after 22:00; complete silence from midnight.

Can we bring a dog?

Yes, just let us know when booking. Dogs are free when renting the whole property. For summer apartment stays the dog fee is CZK 250 per night. The complex is fully fenced.

Is the complex accessible?

A ramp leads into the complex, to the pool and onto the terrace. Apartment no. 1 has access via a ramp without steps; the others are up steps.

Is the pool open all year?

No, the pool is open from May to September.

Is the pool safe for small children?

The pool is not fenced. It has a sliding cover, which we recommend keeping closed whenever nobody is swimming so that no small child or animal can fall in. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.

Do you have a cot?

Yes, add it directly when booking.

Is there an iron in the apartment?

Yes, every apartment has an iron, ironing board and clothes airer.

Is the complex suitable for a company event?

Yes. There is a projector that shows on the wall behind the stage, a flipchart and Wi-Fi in the accommodation area. We issue invoices to companies.

Do prices include VAT?

Yes, all prices on the website include VAT.

Is the road passable in winter?

In winter the access road can be difficult to drive on. Please call us the day before arrival on +420 775 704 669 and we will tell you the current conditions and advise you.

Are there cameras on site?

The outdoor areas are monitored for safety. We only review recordings if a problem occurs.

What if we forget something?

The vending machine on the terrace has drinks, sweets and items like chargers, plasters and hand cream.
